preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices N for each test case is between 2 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= N and 1 <= v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u_i, v_i) has vertices within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for edges in edge_lists)
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 edges forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(min_edges_to_add[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line corresponds to the minimum number of edges to add for the respective test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(min_edges_to_add[i], int) and min_edges_to_add[i] >= 0 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to add is a non-negative integer.
